summary.title: Daily Workflow Summary — 2024-01-15
summary.content:
Good progress today. The main design review was completed and two pull requests are ready to merge pending final approval. The vendor follow-up email went out this morning.

Two items are carried over from last week: the API documentation update and the team retrospective notes. Both need attention before the end of the week.

Key blocker: the staging environment is still showing intermittent errors that are blocking QA. This needs to be escalated.
